guidelines.title: Factual, non-coercive enterprise tone
guidelines.description: Communicate product capabilities transparently without false urgency, intimidation, or absolute guarantees.

guidelines.title: No absolute security or zero-risk guarantees
guidelines.description: Never state that any software or cloud service is 100% hack-proof, unbreachable, or eliminates all risk.

guidelines.title: Accurate data residency and GDPR retention disclosure
guidelines.description: Privacy notices must state retention timelines and avoid claiming indefinite third-party sharing without consent.
